description: Create a Sales Order
name: create_sales_order

description: Create a Sales Invoice
name: create_sales_invoice

description: Create a Customer (usually run automatically as a follow-up step when a Sales Order/Invoice references a Customer that doesn't exist yet)
name: create_customer

description: Create an Item (or multiple, comma-separated)
name: create_item

description: Create a Supplier (usually run automatically as a follow-up step when a Purchase Order/Invoice/Receipt references a Supplier that doesn't exist yet)
name: create_supplier

description: Create a Purchase Order
parameters: {"supplier": "string (required)", "items": "list of {item_name, qty}", "due_date": "string (optional, YYYY-MM-DD) -- used as each item's schedule date"}
name: create_purchase_order

description: Create a Purchase Invoice
name: create_purchase_invoice

description: Create a Purchase Receipt
name: create_purchase_receipt

description: Create a Delivery Note
parameters: {"customer": "string (required)", "items": "list of {item_name, qty}", "due_date": "string (optional, YYYY-MM-DD) -- used as the posting date"}
name: create_delivery_note

description: Create a Quotation for a Customer
name: create_quotation

description: Create a Supplier Quotation
name: create_supplier_quotation

description: Create a Sales Return (credit note) against an existing Sales Invoice
parameters: {"sales_invoice": "string (required) -- name of the existing Sales Invoice to return"}
name: create_sales_return

description: Create a Purchase Return (debit note) against an existing Purchase Receipt
parameters: {"purchase_receipt": "string (required) -- name of the existing Purchase Receipt to return"}
name: create_purchase_return

description: Create a Material Request
name: create_material_request

description: Create a Stock Entry (Material Receipt, Issue, or Transfer)
parameters: {"items": "list of {item_name, qty}", "purpose": "string (optional, default 'Material Receipt'; one of 'Material Receipt', 'Material Issue', 'Material Transfer')", "source_warehouse": "string (required for Issue/Transfer)", "target_warehouse": "string (required for Receipt/Transfer)"}
name: create_stock_entry

description: Create a Stock Reconciliation for a warehouse
name: create_stock_reconciliation

description: Record a Payment Entry (receive from a Customer or pay a Supplier). Real Chart of Accounts names required -- no defaults are guessed.
parameters: {"party_type": "string (required) -- 'Customer' or 'Supplier'", "party": "string (required)", "amount": "number (required)", "payment_type": "string (optional, default 'Receive' for Customer / 'Pay' for Supplier)", "paid_from_account": "string (required) -- real account name from Chart of Accounts", "paid_to_account": "string (required) -- real account name from Chart of Accounts"}
name: create_payment_entry

description: Create a balanced Journal Entry. Real Chart of Accounts names required -- no defaults are guessed.
parameters: {"accounts": "list of {account, debit_in_account_currency, credit_in_account_currency} -- must balance (total debit == total credit)", "posting_date": "string (optional, YYYY-MM-DD)"}
name: create_journal_entry

description: Create an Employee record
parameters: {"first_name": "string (required)", "last_name": "string (optional)", "gender": "string (required) -- e.g. 'Male', 'Female', 'Other'", "date_of_joining": "string (optional, YYYY-MM-DD)", "company": "string (optional, defaults to the only/first Company)"}
name: create_employee

description: Create a Leave Application for an existing Employee
parameters: {"employee": "string (required) -- must be an existing Employee", "leave_type": "string (required)", "from_date": "string (required, YYYY-MM-DD)", "to_date": "string (required, YYYY-MM-DD)"}
name: create_leave_application

description: Mark Attendance for an existing Employee
parameters: {"employee": "string (required) -- must be an existing Employee", "attendance_date": "string (optional, YYYY-MM-DD, default today)", "status": "string (optional, default 'Present') -- one of 'Present', 'Absent', 'On Leave', 'Half Day', 'Work From Home'"}
name: create_attendance

description: Create a Bill of Materials for a production Item
name: create_bom

description: Create a Work Order for a production Item, using its default BOM unless bom_no is given
name: create_work_order

description: Create a Project
name: create_project

description: Create a Task, optionally under an existing Project
name: create_task

description: Create a CRM Organization (Frappe CRM app, not ERPNext). Usually run automatically as a follow-up step when a CRM Deal references an organization that doesn't exist yet.
name: create_crm_organization

description: Create a Lead in Frappe CRM (the standalone CRM app -- separate from ERPNext's Lead doctype).
name: create_crm_lead

description: Create a Deal in Frappe CRM against an existing CRM Organization.
name: create_crm_deal

description: Create a Customer in Frappe Helpdesk (HD Customer). Field names for this doctype had the least documentation coverage of everything added so far -- verify against your installed Helpdesk version if it errors.
name: create_hd_customer

description: Create a Support Ticket in Frappe Helpdesk.
parameters: {"subject": "string (required)", "description": "string (optional)", "priority": "string (optional, default 'Medium') -- one of 'Low','Medium','High','Urgent'", "raised_by": "string (optional) -- email of the reporter", "ticket_type": "string (optional)"}
name: create_hd_ticket
